course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: From the time a request for data is submitted until the request is fulfilled, a database takes an average of 3 seconds to respond to a request for data. The database is found to be idle around 20% of the time. Answer the following questions assuming that the database can be modeled as an M/M/1 queue system.
i) What is the average service time per database query?
ii) What is the average number of queries in the system?
iii) What is the probability that 5 or more queries are present?
